baseline: 二维简单游戏：移动／碰撞、玩家、少量简单 NPC、基础战斗、背包／掉落、一种基础射弹、预置小世界。

L0.title: 基础运行
L0.definition: 当前实体身份、空间权威状态和世界加载链路的基础支撑。保留核心能力。

L1.title: 基本玩法
L1.definition: 所选简单游戏的移动、玩家、简单 NPC、基本战斗和物品闭环。

L2.title: 通用可选玩法
L2.definition: 装备、状态效果、容器、合成、液体等。启用该玩法才需要。

L3.title: 专用扩展玩法
L3.definition: 泰拉瑞亚特定内容、复杂子玩法、首领事件及特殊世界生成。

L4.title: 表现、诊断与候选模型
L4.definition: 呈现和仪表，或经对照发现未接入的平行状态模型。

system_catalog.name: ContentCatalogBuildSystem
system_catalog.summary: Validates content references before publishing an immutable runtime catalog.

system_catalog.name: WorldItemMotionSystem
system_catalog.summary: Validates and commits revisioned world-item motion state.

system_catalog.name: WorldItemReservationSystem
system_catalog.summary: Applies reservation transitions to world-item components supplied by their ECS owner. The owner resolves the item through the shared EntityRuntime, verifies active world presence, and calls this system on the runtime's owner thread.

system_catalog.name: LeashedEntityRegistrationSystem
system_catalog.summary: Owns Leashed runtime roots, legacy slot projections, section membership and anchor links. Mutating operations preflight affected runtime roots before committing. Commits invoke no external callbacks and rely on EntityRuntime's owner-thread access contract to prevent an intervening borrow or lifecycle change. Network, tile entity, NPC and projectile effects remain outside this core system.

system_catalog.name: NpcSpawnSlotProtectionSystem
system_catalog.summary: Recomputes each slot in order. Active slots do not read their previous protection value.

system_catalog.name: NpcSpawnSlotSelectionSystem
system_catalog.summary: Selects from the captured slot facts and protects a slot that is safe to commit.

system_catalog.name: NpcSpawnSystem
system_catalog.summary: Runs the Version4 entry ordering and reports only effects observable through the current ports. A continuation request is legacy loop control; it is not an entity-creation result.

system_catalog.name: NpcTaskLifecycleSystem
system_catalog.summary: Advances a task when the caller owns a synchronous, current-state operation. Delayed or leased work must use the reference-bound overload.

system_catalog.name: PlayerLifecycleSystem
system_catalog.summary: Projects packet 16's life derived dead flag into lifecycle state.

system_catalog.name: PlayerNetworkStateSystem
system_catalog.summary: Detached results and state updates used by the network player owner.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileDamageHitboxSystem
system_catalog.summary: Maps Version4 Damage_GetHitbox, including its LocalAi0 write for expanding projectiles of types 301, 383, and 262.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileEffectCooldownSystem
system_catalog.summary: Applies the shared positive-value decrement. Call once per eligible projectile substep after Update's early-outs and before AI.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileLifecycleSystem
system_catalog.summary: Serial owner for projectile slot allocation, identity registration, and release. Callers must serialize access to the supplied world storage.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileMotionAndAiSystem
system_catalog.summary: Applies mapped projectile motion and presentation rules.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileNetworkStateSystem
system_catalog.summary: Begins one entered Version4 projectile update substep. The immediate update request is transient; a deferred request remains pending.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileStaticNpcImmunitySystem
system_catalog.summary: Owns Version4's shared per-projectile-type NPC immunity expiry table.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileTickPreparationSystem
system_catalog.summary: Applies a confirmed early-out from the Version4 projectile update prefix.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileTrailCacheSystem
system_catalog.summary: Returns the Version4 TrailingMode value for a projectile type. Unlisted projectile types use the source set's default value, -1. Source: Version4 Terraria.ID.ProjectileID.cs:291.

system_catalog.name: ProjectileWetStateSystem
system_catalog.summary: Updates persistent wet-state flags and the transition cooldown.

system_catalog.name: BeachBoundaryCalculationSystem
system_catalog.summary: Commits the pure beach-boundary calculation to its generation-scoped component.

system_catalog.name: BeachBoundarySystem
system_catalog.summary: Commits one complete beach-boundary snapshot for its generation session.

system_catalog.name: DungeonLayoutControlSystem
system_catalog.summary: Commits dungeon layout facts without taking ownership of external dungeon-record fields.

system_catalog.name: DungeonLayoutResetSystem
system_catalog.summary: Resets generation-scoped dungeon layout state at the dungeon setup barrier.

system_catalog.name: DungeonSelectionControlSystem
system_catalog.summary: Applies the source-compatible active-dungeon selection command.

system_catalog.name: DungeonSpecialRewardGenerationResetSystem
system_catalog.summary: Resets generation-scoped unique dungeon reward results.

system_catalog.name: FallenLogFlowerHandoffSystem
system_catalog.summary: Owns producer and one-shot consumer transitions for the fallen-log handoff.

system_catalog.name: FloatingIslandPlacementResetSystem
system_catalog.summary: Resets floating-island house progress while retaining the sky-lake target.

system_catalog.name: HellChestLootCycleSystem
system_catalog.summary: Advances the hell-chest cursor only after the external chest commit succeeds.

system_catalog.name: HousingRoomScoreSystem

system_catalog.name: HousingValidationSystem

system_catalog.name: JungleChestLootSelectionSystem

system_catalog.name: JungleChestPlacementSystem

system_catalog.name: JungleRegionStructureSystem
